sections.markdown:
# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. Clinical/legal review remains required for emergency and collision guidance. The source conflicts on brake pumping and ABS behavior across physical118–121; do not teach its detailed procedures or a guarantee of stopping distance. Jump-start vent-cap and negative-terminal instructions, pressure-equalization/side-window escape details, child rescue sequence, impact bracing, choosing collision targets, fixed blowout speed and quantitative flood/float limits are withheld for vehicle-specific safety review. Physical116 age-specific phone wording differs from the later hands-free rule; preserve the currentness issue rather than imply one resolves the other. The move-over rule must retain safe-lane-change qualification from physical126. Dated teen and collision statistics remain unasserted; source-based first-aid detail is not a clinical training module. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.
